bio: When Durboll barks an order at you, you do it. Fast. He's the foreman of the rock-hard Deepcast Dwarves who toil in the very depths of Stoneloom's Pits, mining bedrock so tough it can withstand Terravun's jaws. He's one of the only Stonehearts who officially knows where Pentiax's Vault is hidden. But shush! Don't let him know we told you...
